title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1500: Blooming skylotus (2)

section.p: With a sneer, Great Zhou King said, “Fools.”
Numerous cold gazes landed on the devil king who had spoken earlier.

That was especially true for the divine king who had just lost a body to Great Qin King. Yes. The victim of the spear attack was the white-haired divine king. He was a ninth-degree Eternal, a powerful ancient expert of the divine race. At the moment, he had an ashen expression.
Three ninth-degree Eternals had attacked at the same time to test humanity, but he had lost a body instantly.
“Bastard!”
The white-haired divine king was furious. Damn the devils!
Damn it!

It was understandable why they were tempted. Great Qin King’s absence would be their best chance to eliminate humanity. Alas, Great Qin King was still around. A ninth-degree Eternal had lost a tri-life body before anyone could even react.
Great Qin King was still as strong as ever.

In fact, he seemed far stronger than expected. No ninth-degree Eternals would try attacking humanity with a tri-life body unless they were certain they could escape. Alas, they had made an error in judgment. Great Qin King? Screw that! Damn the devils!
The divines were furious. They had been elevated to the biggest loser in the mansion. They had lost three Eternals. With one being a seventh-degree Eternal.

Additionally, they had also lost the tri-life body of a ninth-degree Eternal. This was a massive loss. The losses of the divines had surpassed even that of the immortals. The immortals had lost only two immortal kings, and none of them was at the seventh degree.

The furious white-haired divine king glared at the devils coldly. Seven devil kings had entered the mansion, but only one had died so far. And Blood Fire Devil King was incredibly strong. Was he really in the mansion?
Nobody could make an accurate judgment.

Too many index holders in the mansion had died. The few remaining ones were too busy fighting to contact those outside. Furthermore, the mansion had stopped shaking violently for quite a while. Blood essence ignition of Invincibles was the sole communication option left for them.
But not even Invincibles were willing to ignite their blood essence lightly. That was usually something one would only do as a last resort.

They wouldn’t ignite their blood essence unless it was something important, such as the appearance of Great Qin King. Alas, only the devils had received the message. Meanwhile, the other races were suspecting that this was a lie.

The devil king in question frowned. Was that information inaccurate? Unlikely. That was a message he had received from a devil king from his clan. There was no way the devil king would lie to him. Furthermore, they were related by blood. It would be a waste for that devil king to ignite his blood essence just to send some fake information out.
But that spear…nobody could deny its existence.
Why?
Two Great Qin Kings?
Which of them was the real Great Qin King?
The devil king could only stay silent. After all, he had caused a divine king to lose a tri-life body. He had earned the ire of the divines while the other races were growing suspicious of him.
He couldn’t explain himself out of this. That spear alone was enough to prove that he was lying. Great Qin King was the only human capable of releasing such an attack.
Eastrift Valley.
The powerful figure in the sky coldly said, “Piss off from the eastern sector. This is not the place for you to strut around arrogantly.”
Behind Great Qin King, a human Invincible appeared and said in astonishment, “Have they gone crazy? Why are they sending their tri-life bodies over with you here?”
Yes. The humans couldn’t understand this.

Three ninth-degree Eternals were powerful enough that no human but Great Qin King could deal with them. But with Great Qin King around, it would be stupid of them to send only their tri-life bodies here.
Were they finding it fun to lose their tri-life bodies? Yes, they could recultivate the lost bodies, but it would be extremely expensive and time-consuming. Were they crazy?

Great Qin King couldn’t be bothered to explain. With a wave of his hand, a carrier treasure appeared. He said, “Not bad. They came bearing treasures. This is a carrier treasure capable of bearing the body of a ninth-degree Eternal.”
His tone turned cold as he said, “Just ignore those annoying bugs.”
He then tossed the carrier treasure behind him and said, “Send it back to the Human Realm.”
“Yes!”

A general appeared and looked at Great Qin King admiringly before starting his escort duty. He knew who the carrier treasure was meant for. It was meant for one of the three injured old human Invincibles. They lacked the ability to get new carrier treasures. Now, one had been delivered right into their hands.
“Old Qin, were they here just to deliver us this gift?” An Invincible asked jokingly.

Great Qin King said, “Who knows? It doesn’t matter. However, looks like things are not going well at the Sea of Stars. Great Han King, Great Shang King, Great Tang King, and Great Song King. The four of you…and Wang Hu. Yes. Take him with you. He’s good at time manipulation. Go to the Sea of Stars and back them up. That should be enough deterrance to prevent the others from trying anything stupid.”
“All of us?”

Great Qin King said, “Very few humans have died this time. The other races must be feeling envious. Go and keep an eye there. Protect the human survivors when they leave the mansion. If the myriad races dare to try anything, split up and wait for my order. We will invade their realms and kill until they pull back from our people.”
“Yes!”
The Invincibles did not protest. Since Great Qin King had a plan, they wouldn’t mind following it. They had also received updates about the massive losses the various races had sustained.

For some reason, the humans were doing very well this time. Even now, they had not lost a single Invincible and Pseudo Invincible. There were also hundreds of survivors below the Invincible Realm. They left without wasting time.
After their departure, a human king looked around and said, “Old Qin, things are rather unstable right now. Should we call Old Zhu over?”
“No. Let him stay in Great Ming.”
Great Qin King said, “That fellow is still sulking. Just let him be. These geezers are getting difficult as they grow older.”
The other Invincibles laughed with amusement upon hearing that.
Someone asked, “Is he…really in the Human Realm? Don’t lie, Old Qin. We’re not stupid. I reckon he’s trying to surpass you guys.”
“Hahaha! I think so as well. Why are you covering for him, Old Qin?”
“Enough. It’s not like Old Zhu has ever been willing to accept Old Qin’s leadership. Why is a boorish guy like him complaining that Old Qin and Old Xia are barbarians?”
Then, the various Invincibles dispersed while laughing with amusement.

With Great Qin King around, they wouldn’t be too worried even when things were getting tense. As long as Great Qin King was present, the worst would not happen. After floating silently by himself for a short moment, Great Qin King vanished with a flicker as well.
He reappeared within the main hall of the Vanguard Regiment. There, he looked in the direction of Sea of Stars with worry on his face. Something had happened to…Old Qin. This was very troublesome.
The death of someone like Old Qin would trigger a massive phenomenon. Everyone would know about it. This wasn’t something they could hide forever.
Suddenly, he called out, “Nan Wujiang.”
After a short while, Nan Wujiang arrived, bowed, and greeted, “Great Qin King.”
Great Qin King said, “Do something for me.”
“Please issue your orders.”
“Take Su Long away in secret and hide him somewhere safe. Don’t tell me his location. Don’t tell anyone except Su Yu.”
Surprise covered Nan Wujiang’s face.
“Go.”
“But…”
Great Qin King said, “Just do it. If you can remain undetected, enter Great Qin and take Qin Hao’s son away as well. Settle him down in a random minor realm.”
Nan Wujiang trembled slightly. He looked at Great Qin King and asked, “You mean…”

“Go.” Great Qin King smiled and said, “There is no special meaning to this. It’s merely the whim of an old man. Qin Hao, Qin Zhen, and even Qin Fang are all gone. If all of them were to die, would the Qin Family end? Just go and take that little fellow away. At the very least, there won’t be anyone around to lead him astray when he’s away as well.”
After a short silence, Nan Wujiang gave Great Qin King a deep gaze before nodding and vanishing. Great Qin King leaned back on his chair and sighed. That…was all he could do for his old friend.
The death of his old friend would throw the entire Human Realm into chaos. He did not have the confidence to keep things calm. He could only try his best to preserve the bloodline of the Qin Family.
“Father!”
“Qin King!”
Luminous Domain Mansion. The human Invincibles were greatly alarmed. Great Qin King had lost one of his tri-life bodies. This was very bad.
“Die!”

With a desperate roar, Xia Longwu swung his blade again and cut down the final body of an immortal king. With one of his own bodies as the price, Xia Longwu had finally killed an immortal king with Qin Zhen’s help.

Only two immortal kings were left. At this point, both Xia Longwu and Qin Zhen were already weakened greatly. They had each lost a body. However, they were more worried about Great Qin King than themselves.
This was very bad.

Even when they were facing four opponents, the two remaining immortal kings did not seem fearful or sad. That was because both Xia Longwu and Qin Zhen were faced with a death sovereign after killing an immortal king. This was one of the prices for killing in the residence.

The newly arrived death sovereign was incredibly powerful, giving the seriously injured Xia Longwu and Qin Zhen a hard time. They also had to fight while holding back since they couldn’t afford to face the consequences of killing a death spirit here. Thus, the situation did not improve for the humans.

They did not have anyone to help transfer their opponents outside the residence for killing. They were forced to do the fighting in the residence. Great Qin King was similarly faced with a powerful death sovereign.

After the deaths of seven Invincibles, six death sovereigns had appeared. No death sovereign had arrived for the death of the first Invincible as that Invincible had been killed outside the residence. Including the previous death sovereigns, seventeen death sovereigns had arrived on the seventh level.

Xia Longwu and Qin Zhen were forced to shift their focus to the death sovereign instead of the other immortal kings after killing their opponent. Anxious, they both looked at Su Yu, hoping to see Su Yu pulling off another miracle.

In fact, Xia Longwu was so desperate he no longer cared about his face. He yelled, “Su Yu, can you think of a way to move this death sovereign away?” Meanwhile, both Su Yu and Lan Tian were receiving a beating from their opponents.
Spiritvenge was fighting Lan Tian while Heavencurse was trying to seal Su Yu without harming or killing him.

It occurred to Su Yu that Heavencurse was really quite strong. So what? What could his strength do? Su Yu believed that Heavencurse would not be able to control his strength perfectly all the time. He only needed to keep struggling until Heavencurse lost control.

Even Su Yu was starting to feel anxious after Great Qin King lost a body. With a roar, he charged toward Heavencurse again. Meanwhile, Heavencurse continued maintaining the distance between them while chanting nonstop. Instantly, a shiny net appeared and dropped down on Su Yu.

One net followed another as Heavencurse said, “You are quite impressive. No wonder the death spirits had agreed to the oath so easily. So this is what you’re planning. Unfortunately, you’re too weak for me to even harm.”
So what if Su Yu had the combat strength of a Pseudo Invincible? He was still too weak. Heavencurse would have killed Su Yu long ago if it weren’t for the oath.
“Sky! Sunder!”
With a swing of his blade, Su Yu damaged part of the nets. However, Heavencurse was able to maintain the nets with a sneer. To keep Su Yu suppressed, he increased the strength of his nets.
Suddenly, Su Yu muttered, “Tai Shan!”
“Tai Shan!”
“Tai Shan!”
The seventh level shook at a far higher intensity than before. Even the ambient source qi in the air went crazy.
At that instance, numerous changes occurred.

Just as Blood Fire Devil King was about to deal a heavy strike to Great Qin King’s past body, he staggered due to the raging source qi in his body. Great Qin King also staggered, but that allowed him to evade the attack and withdraw safely.

An immortal king was able to escape a fatal attack thanks to the sudden disturbance. As for Heavencurse, he lost control over his nets just as he was pouring more power into them. With a rumble, the nets sliced into Su Yu’s body.
However, the bloodied Su Yu merely looked up at Heavencurse and grinned.
Game over.
